# Claude inbox

This draft PR is a doorbell, not a change. A Claude Code session watches it, and every comment here wakes that session.

- `.github/workflows/claude-inbox.yml` comments here automatically when new art lands in `godot-demo/styles/` or `art/`, when an issue opens, or when a comment signed **Harry:** is posted anywhere.
- To reach the session yourself, comment here.

Don't merge or close it.
